text: I'm drawing the database schema for our blog so the backend team can review it. Users connects to Posts, and Posts connects to Comments. Likes should connect to Posts too, with a dotted line. Tags is a small blue diamond, make it that way. Is Comments directly linked to Users? Move Tags below Posts. Make Users large. Which shape has the most connections? Label Posts as "Articles", since that's the name in the product. Rename Likes to Reactions. Duplicate Comments once, we need a second table. How many arrows are there in total? Undo the last rename if the team prefers Likes. Thanks, this looks much cleaner now.

We are planning the campsite layout for the scout trip and I want the tents to be clear. Tent1 and Tent2 face the Fire, so put them above it. Parking should be at the bottom left, the cars must stay away from the tents. Lake is to the right of the Fire. Connect Parking to Tent1 with a dashed line. Make Fire orange so the kids can find it. Which shape is the farthest from Parking? Is Tent2 near Fire? Arrange the tents in a row. Rename Lake to Pond, the kids call it that. Put a small green circle named Tree near the Fire. Count how many things we have. Thanks, the scouts will love this!

This is my timetable for the school year, I'm drawing it so the parents can understand the day. Math comes first, then Science, then History. Connect those in a chain. Art and Gym should be next to each other on the right. Lunch sits between History and Art, put it there. Make Lunch yellow because everyone loves lunch. Is Gym left of Art? Hmm, I think it's the other way round, so move Gym to the left of Art. Which shape is the leftmost? Describe the whole timetable for the school website. Show me all the yellow shapes. Rename Gym to PE, that's what the kids say. Undo the last move if the layout becomes confusing. Thanks, the principal is reviewing this on Monday.
Lay the sections out in a circle. Desk should be in the middle. Is Kids next to Desk? Make Fiction blue.
Connect Airport to Central, and Central to Harbor. Museum is between Central and Harbor. Make Airport gold. Is there a path from Airport to Museum?
Connect Alice to Bob with an arrow. Carl should be left of Bob. Make Carl purple.
Duplicate Node3 twice. Delete Node4. Count how many shapes are left.
Connect Root to Docs, Images and Code. Make Code blue. Is Images directly linked to Root? Which shape has the most connections?
Gamers join the Guild, and the Guild lives on the Server. Connect Gamer to Guild and Guild to Server. Put Server at the top.
Make Blob huge.
Swap Alpha1 with Beta2. Make the Alpha2 green. How many shapes are there?
From now on triangles are teal. Move Dog to the left of Cat. Is Bird teal?
The waiter takes orders from the table. Connect Table to Waiter and Waiter to Chef. Describe the diagram for the staff manual.
Move the Bar behind the Crowd, put it above the Crowd. Is Stage larger than Crowd? Make Stage huge. Count the shapes.
Put them in a grid. Show me the shapes that are circles.
The ship docks at the port and the crane unloads it. Connect Ship to Port and Crane to Port. Make Crane orange. What is the degree of Port?
Mic goes into Amp, and Amp goes into Speaker. Rename Amp to Mixer.
Connect Node1 to Node2 with a dotted arrow, it's a weak link.
Make the Sun a huge yellow circle. Earth should be left of the Sun. Is Earth tiny?
Undo that. Redo that. Undo once more.
Label Alpha as Start. Label Beta as End.
Send Back to the back, bring Front to the front. Is Side bigger than Back?
Connect Handle to Pot with dotted lines. Connect Lid to Pot with dotted lines too. Make Lid gray. Is there a cycle?
Put every animal in a row, then align them horizontally. Make Eel small. Which shape is the topmost?
Connect Spring to Summer to Fall to Winter. Is there a path from Winter to Spring? Count the arrows.

Our comic book storyboard has six panels and I'm placing them on the canvas. Hero starts at the bottom left, and the Villain waits at the Castle. Move Villain above Castle. Sidekick walks beside the Hero, so put it to the right of Hero. Connect Hero to Gate and Gate to Castle. Make the Map gray, it's just background. Is the Castle bigger than the Gate? Duplicate Gate once for a second door. Which shape is the leftmost? Rename Map to Background. Thanks, the artist will start on this Friday.

Writing out my bread recipe as a flowchart so my kids can follow it. Dough is the first box. Connect Dough to Mix, and Yeast to Mix, and Water to Mix. Mix goes to Rest, then Rest goes to Bake. Hmm, Bake should be before Cool, right? Yes, so connect Bake to Cool. Make Rest blue because it's the waiting step. Put Cool at the far right. Is there a path from Water to Cool? How many steps are there? Which shape has the most connections? Make Yeast small. Undo the last change if the flow looks wrong. Rename Mix to Knead.

Office map for the new hire orientation, I'm keeping it simple. Lobby is the entry, put it at the bottom center. Desk should be above the Lobby. Meeting is next to Desk, to the right. Kitchen and Restroom go on the left side. Connect Lobby to Desk and Lobby to Meeting. Make Kitchen teal. Is Restroom left of Desk? Which shape is closest to Lobby? Describe the whole map for the handbook. Oops, I meant the Kitchen to be big, make it large. Thanks, the new hires need this by Monday.

Okay, sketching a machine learning pipeline for the team wiki. Input goes to Filter, then to Model, then to Output. Connect them as a chain. Logs should get a copy from Model, so connect Model to Logs with a dashed line. Make Model purple. Is there a cycle in this pipeline? Put Output on the far right. What's the shortest path from Input to Logs? Which shape is the least connected? Rename Filter to Clean. Count the arrows in total. Thanks!

This is for the hospital discharge process, my manager wants a simple diagram. Patient comes in and goes to Triage. Triage sends people to Ward or Icu. Connect Triage to Ward and Icu. Ward sends people home when they're ready, so connect Ward to Home. Make Icu red. Is Home reachable from Patient? Move Home to the bottom right corner. Which shape has the most connections? Describe the diagram for the audit. Thanks.

Hi, I'm making a diagram of our radio check procedure for the drill team. Alpha calls Bravo first. Bravo answers Charlie, and Charlie answers Delta. Connect Alpha to Bravo, Bravo to Charlie, and Charlie to Delta. Echo is the supervisor, so put Echo at the top center. Make Echo red. Foxtrot should be near Delta. Is there a path from Alpha to Foxtrot? Hmm, Foxtrot isn't linked yet. Connect Delta to Foxtrot with a dashed line. Which shape has the most connections? Move Charlie a bit to the left, around 30 pixels. Are Alpha and Echo directly linked? Duplicate Bravo twice for the backup radios. Rename Echo to Control. Undo the last thing if the chain looks broken. Thanks, I'll test it tomorrow.

Sprint board update for the standup, cleaning it up before 9am. Story1 and Story2 are in the sprint now. Move Story2 below Story1. Make Done green. Make Review yellow. Connect Story1 to Review and Story2 to Review. Connect Review to Done. Is Done connected to Sprint? Sprint should be at the top. Which shape has the fewest connections? Rename Story2 to Story2b, we split it. Duplicate Story1 once, one more story is coming. Count the shapes on the board. Thanks, the team needs this in 5 minutes.
Put Label above Input. Put Button below Input. Make Button blue. Is Input tiny?
Make Bob large, bigger than Alice. Is Bob bigger than Alice?
Describe Book, and then list all the squares.
Align Top1 and Top2 on the horizontal axis. Distribute Top3 and Top4 horizontally too.
Phone connects to Cloud, Cloud connects to Server, Server connects back to Phone. Is there a cycle in this? Make Cloud white.
Put Basil near Pot. Mint should be left of Basil. Is Mint red? Make Pot brown.
Connect Ping, Pong and Pang all to each other, so all three are linked.
Red1 is red. Blue1 is blue. Green1 is green. How many shapes are blue?
Make the Start a green star. Make Stop a red square. Connect Start to Stop with a plain arrow.
Show the list of shapes right of Left. Put Top at the top center.
Make Teal1 teal. Teal2 is teal too. Is Teal1 near Teal2?
Move Sale 20 pixels to the right and then move Price up 15 pixels.
Connect Mark to Ellen, Ellen to Joe, Joe to Lisa. Then connect Lisa to Mark. Is there a cycle?
Make Electron a small circle, and put it right of Core. Shell should be huge. Is Electron right of Core?
Connect Node1 to Node2 and Node1 to Node3. What's the degree of Node1? Make Node2 green.
Hall connects Gate1 and Gate2. Remove the link between Hall and Gate2, the gate is closed.
Delete Cloud1, please.
Make the Bolt red. Make the Arc blue. Which shape is the smallest?
